placements.why: Establishes the organizational category for system recovery strategies, fault tolerance, and resilience verification.
placements.title: Reliability and Resilience
placements.frame: How does the system maintain reliability and verify recovery mechanisms under operational conditions?

placements.title: Rollback capability exists only through active rehearsal
placements.frame: How does regular rehearsal validate that rollback and recovery mechanisms genuinely function?
placements.why: Quinton institutes a mandatory monthly rehearsal cadence based on the axiom that an unrehearsed rollback does not constitute a genuine operational capability.
